HTTPoison is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2) and [Libraries](@/projects/libraries.md) (1).

Most recently: [hydra](@/work/hydra.md): Modular wrapper and interface for pool of orchestrated Google Chrome instances; [microcrawler-elixir](@/work/microcrawler-elixir.md): Microcrawler Implemented in Elixir; [gooddata-graphql](@/work/gooddata-graphql.md): GoodData Web Application Written in Elixir.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses HTTPoison: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links HTTPoison to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
